name: What is the installation process for a hardwired bathroom night light?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for a hardwired bathroom night light?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a hardwired bathroom night light, our process begins with a consultation to understand your needs and choose the appropriate fixture and location. Next, our licensed electrician will safely run new electrical wiring, if necessary, from an existing power source to the chosen spot. This often involves opening walls or ceilings, which we meticulously repair afterwards. The light fixture is then securely mounted and connected to the electrical system. Finally, we test the light to ensure proper function and clean up the work area, leaving your bathroom ready for use.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, running new electrical wiring, mounting and connecting the fixture, testing, and cleanup by a licensed electrician.
